title: Priority 1 clause-pairing regression fixtures
purpose: Small human-review benchmark for subject correspondence, not a complete legal interpretation dataset.

cases.earlier_excerpt: 01.02.2019 and no changes thereafter shall be considered for eligibility of benefit under the
cases.later_excerpt: Transferees are not entitled for any benefits under PM-KISAN in such cases.
cases.reason: The earlier passage concerns a dated eligibility cut-off; the later passage concerns inheritance/transferee status. Exact quote location on each page does not make them the same provision.

cases.earlier_excerpt: However, all the PMEGP units should be encouraged to registered under Udyam Portal
cases.later_excerpt: Besides, all the PMEGP units will have to be mandatorily registered under Udyam
cases.reason: Both excerpts concern Udyam registration. The substantive obligation/force changes and still warrants checking the full clause.

cases.earlier_excerpt: EDP training is a mandatory training to be undergone by beneficiary to be eligible for sanction
cases.later_excerpt: EDP training is mandatory for claiming the Margin Money subsidy. No EDP training will be mandatory for projects up to Rs. 2 lakh.
cases.reason: Both excerpts concern EDP training; applicability and exceptions differ, so this is a provisional modification candidate requiring human review.

cases.earlier_excerpt: As per the scheme guidelines, 100% physical verification is mandatory for all the unit's setup
cases.later_excerpt: 100% physical verification with geo-tagging of the actual establishment and working status of each of the units set up under PMEGP will be done by KVIC.
cases.reason: Both excerpts concern physical verification; automated matching must prevent a false removal, while human review determines exact scope/conditions.
